title: Bovine Satellite Cell Pax7 Immunocytochemistry
author: Andrew Stout
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xzyfp7w
materials: Dilute primary antibodies in wash buffer and keep on ice (protected from light). For given antibody, use the following dilutions: anti-Pax7 (1:500) Phalloidin-594 (1:100) note* prepare enough antibody solution for all conditions (a little extra is usually good to make sure there is enough)
Add primary antibody solutions and incubate overnight at 4C (parafilm to avoid evaporation)

Dilute secondary antibodies in wash buffer and keep on ice (protected from light). For given antibody, use the following dilutions: 488 goat-anti-rabbit (1:500) note* prepare enough antibody solution for all conditions (a little extra is usually good to make sure there is enough)

steps.title: Fix cells with PFA
steps.instruction: Add cold 4 % paraformaldehyde (PFA) to the cells, using enough volume to completely cover the cells or scaffolds, then incubate at room temperature for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Wash with PBS
steps.instruction: Wash the cells three times with room‑temperature PBS. After this wash you may cover the plate with parafilm and store it in the refrigerator overnight (or up to 1 week) before proceeding with staining.

steps.title: Permeabilize cells
steps.instruction: Aspirate the PBS, add cold permeabilization solution to cover the cells, and incubate for 15 minutes at 4 °C (cold).

steps.title: Wash with PBST (first)
steps.instruction: Wash the cells three times with cold PBST (PBS + 0.1 % Tween‑20).

steps.title: Incubate in Wash buffer (45 min)
steps.instruction: Aspirate the PBST and add cold Wash buffer to cover the cells; incubate for 45 minutes at 4 °C. During this soak you may proceed to the next washing step (step 8).

steps.title: Wash with PBST (second)
steps.instruction: After the 45‑minute incubation, wash the cells three times with cold PBST.

steps.title: Wash with PBST (third)
steps.instruction: Wash the cells three additional times with cold PBST.

steps.title: Incubate in Wash buffer (15 min)
steps.instruction: Aspirate the PBST and add cold Wash buffer again; incubate for 15 minutes at 4 °C. During this soak you may move to the secondary‑antibody step (step 13).

steps.title: Add secondary antibodies
steps.instruction: After the 15‑minute incubation, aspirate the Wash buffer, add the appropriate secondary‑antibody solution, and incubate in the dark at room temperature for 60 minutes.

steps.title: Final PBST washes
steps.instruction: Wash the cells three times with cold PBST, allowing the last wash to soak for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Mount with DAPI and image
steps.instruction: Aspirate the final PBST, add DAPI mounting medium, cover with a coverslip, and acquire images after 10 minutes. (Pax7 = green, actin cytoskeleton = red, nuclei = blue)
